data_review_amendment.timing: Before any v20 student training or model generation evaluation

second_data_review_amendment.finding: Whole-token exclusion missed split 宇宙+人. Added text/kana regression guard, uncertain standalone実/じつ quarantine, and habitual existential seed-artifact rule.

final_data_amendment.timing: Before100k student training; small-data control already training independently
final_data_amendment.finding: Two grammatical existence/location/connective issues in60-row review; conservative locative-de/existence rejection and やがて prefix exclusion.

last_reading_amendment: Before100k model training: reviewed sample found何より/なんより; add a direct text/kana quarantine. Sample itself contains one remaining awkward adverb clause and narrative/context-dependent prose, so not a corpus-wide quality certification.
